user.title: Configure V15 Lastmanagement
user.description: Choose a grid power sensor and approved load switches. Automatic restoration only switches loads back on if V15 itself switched them off earlier in the same run. **Live load control is disabled after every restart.**

data.load_switches: Switches eligible for load shedding (in priority order)
data.auto_restore: Automatically switch previously shed loads back on

data_description.grid_sensor: Current grid power sensor, in W or kW. Positive values should normally indicate grid import.
data_description.limit_kw: Target maximum average grid import during each fixed 15-minute interval starting at :00, :15, :30 or :45.
data_description.reserve_kw: Safety headroom below the threshold. For example, 5.0 kW limit minus 0.5 kW reserve gives a 4.5 kW target.
data_description.reverse_sign: Enable only if your sensor reports grid import as a negative value.
data_description.stale_seconds: Older measurements are treated as invalid. V15 does not switch any loads when measurements are invalid.
data_description.load_switches: Select only explicitly approved, non-critical switches. The order determines which load is shed first.
data_description.auto_restore: Only loads that V15 itself switched off in this run can be restored after sufficient power headroom. Live control must also be enabled separately.
data_description.restore_stable_seconds: Available headroom must remain sufficient for this long before restoration is permitted.
data_description.restore_min_off_seconds: A load shed by V15 remains off for at least this period, even if headroom becomes available sooner.
data_description.restore_margin_watts: Extra headroom, in watts, required in addition to the estimated load power when switching it on.

restore.title: Estimated maximum power per load (W)
restore.description:
**Why are these values needed?** Before switching a load back on, V15 checks whether its expected power **plus an additional safety margin** fits into the available power budget.

**Enter a conservative maximum power estimate in watts for each switch**, preferably including any startup surge. Do not enter average consumption or **kW**. Example: Enter `600` for a load that can draw up to 600 W. Underestimating the power can cause a threshold exceedance.

**Selected switches (same order as the input fields):**
{switches}

Only loads previously switched off by V15 are restored automatically. Restarting or changing settings does not restore earlier loads.

error.reserve_too_high: The safety reserve must be lower than the threshold.
error.restore_requires_loads: Select at least one load switch to enable automatic restoration.

init.title: V15 Lastmanagement – Settings
init.description: Configure load shedding and automatic restoration. Restoration is optional. If enabled, a second page asks for **estimated maximum power in watts** for each selected switch. Changing settings resets the current restoration state.
